info.title: Avi TrustedHostProfile Object API
info.description:
Avi TrustedHostProfile object api
```
- configure trustedhostprofile <key>
- show trustedhostprofile <key>
```

API permission: PERMISSION_SYSTEMCONFIGURATION

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: object name

parameters.name: refers_to
parameters.description: Filter to request all objects that refers to another Avi resource. Its syntax is refers_to=<obj_type>:<obj_uuid>. Eg. get all virtual services referring to pool p1 will be refers_to=pool:pool_p1_uuid

parameters.name: referred_by
parameters.description: Filter to request all objects that are referred by another Avi resource. Its syntax is referred_by=<obj_type>:<obj_uuid>. Eg. get all pools referred_by virtual service vs1 - referred_by=virtualservice:vs_vs1_uuid

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: List of fields to be returned for the resource. Some fields like name, URL, uuid etc. are always returned.

parameters.name: include_name
parameters.description: All the Avi REST reference URIs have a name suffix as URI#name. It is useful to get the referenced resource name without performing get on that object.

parameters.name: skip_default
parameters.description: Default values are not set.

parameters.name: join_subresources
parameters.description: It automatically returns additional dependent resources like runtime. Eg. join_subresources=runtime.

parameters.name: X-Avi-Version
parameters.description: The caller is required to set Avi Version Header to the expected version of configuration. The response from the controller will provide and accept data according to the specified version. The controller will reject POST and PUT requests where the data is not compatible with the specified version.

parameters.name: X-CSRFToken
parameters.description: Avi Controller may send back CSRF token in the response cookies. The caller should update the request headers with this token else controller will reject requests.

version.description: Version sequence number that monotonically advances with each configuration update event. Field introduced in 21.1.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

addr.description: IP address. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

type.description: Enum options - V4, DNS, V6. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

host.description: Any valid IPv4, IPv6, or domain address. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

port.description: Optionally specify the port number. Allowed values are 1-65535. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

_last_modified.description: UNIX time since epoch in microseconds. Units(MICROSECONDS).

configpb_attributes.description: Protobuf versioning for config pbs. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

hosts.description: List of Host IP(v4/v6) addresses or FQDNs. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Minimum of 1 items required. Maximum of 20 items allowed. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

name.description: TrustedHostProfile name. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

tenant_ref.description: Tenant ref for trusted host profile. It is a reference to an object of type Tenant. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

uuid.description: TrustedHostProfile UUID. Field introduced in 31.1.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.
